summary: Jeremy Ray Staat, born October 10, 1976, is a former American football defensive end. The note says he played for the Pittsburgh Steelers starting in 1998 and for the St. Louis Rams for two games in 2003. It also mentions that he played for the Los Angeles Avengers arena football team and that he is a United States Marine who has served in Iraq.
one_line: Jeremy Staat is a former American football defensive end who played for the Steelers and Rams and later served as a Marine in Iraq.
